title: An imported work order's Reassign lead is disabled with its own tooltip
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Work Orders page (Tech View or Board View) on the build under test, signed in with permission to reassign work orders.
  2. At least one work order is in Imported status (for example S2-17578).
  3. At least 2 lead technicians are shown as groups/columns.
custom_steps:
1. On the Imported work order, find the Reassign lead technician action (it is shown disabled).
  2. Hover the disabled action and read the tooltip.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The disabled Reassign lead technician action on an Imported work order shows the tooltip "The lead technician can't be changed on an imported work order."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S4-N9 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N9: “The disabled Reassign lead technician action on an Imported work order shows this tooltip: “The lead technician can’t be changed on an imported work order.””
